checks.detail: Panel A is extracted from the exact/high-precision R0.71W certificate and its independent reconstruction. Panels B and C are a finite retained Fourier-coset DOP853 plus nonlinear least-squares corroboration. The retained-coset calculation includes every retained convolution mode and a stated time-tail upper bound. It is not DNS, does not prove spectral-truncation convergence or the uniform continuum implicit-function theorem, and does not prove any Navier-Stokes regularity claim. The amplitude-doped data have unbounded initial energy and enstrophy, so the result tests a data-uniform ledger only.
